finding: Blank sidecar keys matched blank packet keys, contaminating multiple rows.
resolution: Adapter v2 forbids blank sidecar keys and never joins incomplete packet keys.

finding: Every packet row was labeled V552_AUTHORITATIVE_PASS_THROUGH, including unmatched rows.
resolution: Adapter v2 assigns row-specific matched, unmatched, missing-key, and matched-empty statuses.

finding: Missing authoritative passthrough columns were silently accepted.
resolution: Adapter v2 requires the full contract field schema.

finding: Partial composite keys containing blanks could match.
resolution: Adapter v2 requires complete sidecar keys and isolates incomplete packet keys.

finding: The file named test_* contained top-level assertions and was not pytest-discoverable.
resolution: A real pytest suite covers key completeness, duplicates, conflicts, schema, statuses, row identity, structured equality, and many-to-one behavior.

finding: 139 pair rulings asserted complete two-sided evidence without row-level provenance references in the ruling surface.
resolution: A 278-row side-level provenance ledger links every ruling to exact nodes, response authority, source masters, and source structures.

finding: Generic accepted-pair rationales said exact item text proved the relation even where a bare battery child required response/parent evidence.
resolution: V2 rationales name the actual source-record basis.

finding: Reworded decisions were encoded by display sequence in the historical builder.
resolution: The v2 decision registry is keyed by stable candidate ID; sequence is display metadata only.

finding: The v13 verifier executed a standalone script and could certify the sidecar without pytest discovery or adversarial blank-key cases.
resolution: The v14 verifier runs pytest and independently checks the v2 contract, evidence ledger, and supersession boundary.

finding: No exact, reworded, structure, or anomaly disposition required reversal after source-native reinspection.
resolution: All 188 substantive records are confirmed at their recorded ceilings; only certification and sidecar implementation changed.
